observation: ZN-E016 (P0 uniform fade): held-out P0 violation 0.150 -> 0.044, loss balance SATISFIED, RMSE 418.6, but MAPE 0.3433 / Acc@15 0.348 worse than ZN-E010 (0.3325 / 0.3665); <500 MAPE 0.200 -> 0.217 because a uniform ramp also shrinks break-in (rising) capacity. Frozen ZN-E010 violates P4b most (0.303 at kappa 1.0; P0 0.150, P0c 0.149, P2 0.226). 32/59 ZN-coin train cells show break-in.
primary_hypothesis: The P4b rule 'accelerating the observed capacity loss cannot lengthen life', which leaves rising (break-in) segments unchanged, lowers the held-out P4b violation by >= 50% vs ZN-E010 without the short-life over-prediction P0 caused, and keeps accuracy: KEEP under §7 vs ZN-E010.
question_inherited: Does a break-in-safe trend physics loss give the P0 physics gain without the short-life accuracy loss?
unresolved_from_reference: Whether the P0 accuracy loss came from perturbing break-in cells.
why_this_experiment: loss.md §4.6 order (P4 -> replaced by P4b because 32/59 cells rise); Gemini ZN-E016 analysis; highest reference violation rate (0.303).
modification: Loss only: L = RelativeHuber_0.15 + lambda * mean ReLU(f(x~) - sg[f(x)]), P4b what-if x~_{n,Q,dis} = x_10 + Delta_n + kappa r_n min(Delta_n, 0) for n >= 11, Delta_n = x_n - x_10, kappa ~ U(0,1), only samples with prefix i >= 20; lambda = 0.5 x median gradient ratio (unsigned calibration). Model and training identical to ZN-E010.
changed_components: Objective: added P4b falling-trend physics term (label-free).
held_constant_components: Frozen ZN-E010 architecture (98,113 params, GELU, anchored fade encoder), Relative Huber delta 0.15 main loss, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epochs, checkpoint rule, data.
controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, split 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps; lambda2 never tuned on validation.
expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE/DB-MAPE vs ZN-E010; held-out P4b violation vs ZN-E010 0.303; <500 band regression; lambda, R, cosine, active fraction; EOL-band bias; gradient gate.
rejection_condition: Primary rule (program.md §7, vs frozen reference ZN-E010 MAPE 0.3325 / RMSE 425.0 / Acc@15 0.3665 / DB-MAPE 0.3325). KEEP iff [A: MAPE <= 0.3245 AND RMSE <= 435.0] OR [B: RMSE <= 404.0 AND MAPE <= 0.3355] OR [C: Acc@15 >= 0.3865 AND MAPE <= 0.3355 AND RMSE <= 435.0], AND Acc@15 >= 0.3365 (A/B) AND DB-MAPE <= 0.3425 AND gradient gate PASS AND loss balance PASS or SATISFIED (loss.md §5.3; BALANCE_FAIL -> DISCARD) AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD; otherwise DISCARD. Physics claim only if the held-out violation rate falls vs ZN-E010 and accuracy does not get worse (loss.md §4.6).
minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; cycle_stem, residual_blocks, fade_encoder, inter_summary and head gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput. Loss balance: lambda2, R_j median, cosine, active fraction (loss.md §5.3).
